samples.xml_description:
Implement an 8-bit multiplier based on shifting and adding operations. First 8-bit input operand (multiplicand). Second 8-bit input operand (multiplier). 16-bit output representing the product of A and B. Parameter N represents the number of bits for inputs A and B. Loop index for iterating through the bits of input B. Shift amount for each addition operation. Flag to indicate whether to add the shifted multiplicand to the product. Flag to indicate whether the multiplication is complete. 16-bit register to store the product. 8-bit register to store the multiplicand. 8-bit register to store the multiplier.

Initialize the product register to zero and set the loop index to zero.

Iterate through each bit of input B:

  1. Shift the multiplicand A left by the current loop index to obtain the shifted multiplicand.
  2. Check if the current bit of B is set:
    • If the bit is set, add the shifted multiplicand to the product register.
    • If the bit is not set, do not add the shifted multiplicand to the product register.
  3. Increment the loop index.

After iterating through all bits of B, assign the product register to the output product.
